SEP-0007 handler test

Temporary page. Open this on your phone and tap each button. It is only checking whether a wallet app claims the web+stellar: scheme — nothing is sent and no transaction is created.

1 — tap: pay request 2 — tap: sign request
What each result means

A wallet app opens (LOBSTR, or a chooser listing it) — the scheme is handled on your device. A LOBSTR mobile flow without WalletConnect is possible.

Nothing happens, or an error / "cannot open page" — no installed app claims the scheme. WalletConnect is the only route to LOBSTR on mobile.

Button 2 uses a deliberately invalid transaction, so a wallet that does open may show a parse error. That still counts as opened — the app claimed the link, which is what we are testing.
